component.name: Vagnarok File Manager
component.summary: Native high-performance file manager written in Rust
Gerenciador de arquivos nativo de alta performance em Rust
Gestor de archivos nativo de alto rendimiento en Rust
Gestionnaire de fichiers natif haute performance en Rust
Gestore di file nativo ad alte prestazioni in Rust

description.p: Vagnarok File Manager is a native GPU-accelerated desktop file manager built 100% in Rust with Iced and wgpu, featuring virtualized Grid and Detail Table views, live directory watching, fuzzy deep search, Git telemetry, ArchiveVfs navigation and password-protected extraction (.zip/.7z/.rar/.tar/.tar.gz), floating Properties windows, and multi-language Project Fluent localization.

Adds interactive password prompt modal and pure-Rust decryption for password-protected .zip (WinZip AES and ZipCrypto), .7z (AES-256), and .rar archives; aggregates recursive total size and item counts in multi-selection Properties; improves Drives sidebar with parent-disk deduplication, smart sorting, two-line disambiguated subtitles, and hardware model tooltips; darkens AetherLight secondary and muted text tokens to WCAG AA+; simplifies view modes to Grid and Detail Table; and resets extension filters cleanly on Escape.

Adds native .iso/.img disk image mounting (opening in a new tab), safe eject and automatic drive hotplug on Linux/Flatpak/Windows, Ctrl+Z undo stack for Trash restore and renames, cascading Send to shortcut submenu (POSIX symlinks on Linux and native COM .lnk on Windows), Shift+Arrows and Shift+Home/End keyboard range selection, custom extension filter input box, smart context menu flipping, and Flatpak trash/default-app fixes.

Adds Open With app discovery and per-type defaults, user-friendly Bulk Rename with live virtualized preview and EXIF/ID3/Regex/Undo support, pure-Rust archive extraction (.zip, .tar, .tar.gz, .7z, .rar) and minimizable background compression (.7z, .zip, .tar, .tar.gz), draggable/opaque modals, quick executable bit toggle, and unified Linux/Windows trash handling.

Adds rubber-band marquee selection, left-to-right Grid alignment by default with toggle, scroll position preservation on context menus, Flatpak bind-mount filtering in Drives, improved sidebar divider/scrollbar layout, and optional hybrid host system icons on Linux and Windows.

Compact Grid cards with background Properties (folder contents and free space), PageUp/PageDown and Ctrl+Q shortcuts, localized tooltips, Nemo-style resizable sidebar with drive mount/unmount actions, and Linux-only Open as root via pkexec.
Fixes Ctrl+Scroll Grid zoom and modifier key tracking on Windows, enables live window decoration toggling on Windows, and applies rustfmt formatting fixes.
Adds Windows Recycle Bin sidebar/listing/restore support, hides the Windows console window in release builds, and fixes duplicate window controls on Windows.
Adds multi-platform packaging (.deb, Flatpak, Windows Inno Setup + portable ZIP), language selector dropdown, Windows filesystem error mapping fixes, and updated project documentation.
First public alpha release: LocalFs, ArchiveVfs, virtualized views, SIMD thumbnails, floating Properties, 6 languages via Project Fluent, and GPLv3 licensing.
